summary: uni and mp backend selection and the UniProc/Multiproc executors are right. No VllmWorker-N or Worker_TPn names. cli_env_setup and _maybe_force_spawn are not modeled. parallel-config.post-init never calls assert_ray_available, so --distributed-executor-backend ray without Ray is accepted.

Monitor wake, failed executor and the EXECUTOR_FAILED engine death are right; log texts are absent. (b) corrected: idle survivors exit on the death pipe, and SIGTERM/SIGKILL apply only to workers still alive after 5 s. (d) fails: collective_rpc joins every rank even with unique_reply_rank, so a rank-0 failure becomes a 300 s TimeoutError instead of RuntimeError. (e) confirmed and reproduced: rank 0 blocks in the all-reduce, TimeoutError after 300 s, engine dead.

FP8 detection and per-layer methods are right. The kernel is a default choice, not computed from capability, and there is no selection log. (b) corrected: fused weight scales are requantized to their max before CUTLASS broadcasts them per channel. (c): the A100 still gets CUTLASS and the forward fails, where the code picks Marlin (cutlass_scaled_mm_supports_fp8(80) is false, confirmed).

get_quant_config is right (deprecation warning, OnlineQuantizationConfig fp8_per_tensor), but the VllmConfig quant_config says fp8, not online. There is no online linear method and no 'Quantizing 128 layers' log (the exact text is confirmed in the md). The forward reaches CUTLASS through Fp8LinearMethod. The fp8_per_tensor shortcut and the checkpoint mismatch error are exact.

MoE TP/EP layout, local expert counts, linear maps, no all2all at DP 1 and the TP all-reduce are right. Worker titles and the EP log line are not modeled. There is no expert_placement_strategy knob and no round-robin fallback.

The three ParallelConfig EPLB validation messages are exact and come before VllmConfig. EPLBConfig defaults and the communicator are not modeled. One redundant expert loads with 4 local experts instead of the even-distribution ValueError. EPLB profile and step rearrangement are not modeled (eplb-state is a stub).

Weights-mode TP-sharded ViT encoding all images in one call is reproduced on rank0 at TP 2 (there is no 2-GPU VL world). Data mode, encoder profiling and ViT backend selection are not modeled. (c) corrected: the profile modality is video, N=32768, M=1.

Backend priority, FA3 and the selected-only validation are right; the logs are absent. The FLASHINFER_MLA message drops the 'AttentionBackendEnum.' prefix, and engine startup succeeds with the flag. (c) corrected: the startup error goes on with 'Failed core proc(s): {...}'; the reason list is confirmed. The dummy loader skips the download, but the seeded uniform fill is not modeled. There is no seed config, and the sampler uses seed 0 for unseeded requests.
